research.text: The Sun lab is interested in both biological and artificial intelligence, with the objective of achieving two complimentary goals: (1) to better understand the biological underpinnings of animal cognition and intelligent behavior, and (2) to use this understanding to improve AI systems. Current work includes using deep learning theories to understand how memories are transformed over time and large-scale 2-photon calcium imaging methods to study learning and cognitive map formation in rodents.
